description: Wide golden wheat fields at sunset lie under a huge storm cloud with a thin tornado on the horizon. A flattened track of bent wheat and a dirt road run through the fields towards the storm. A young woman in a plaid shirt and shorts stands on the roof of a dusty white pickup with her arms raised, and a young man sits beside her pointing at the tornado. A dark car drives up the dirt road in a cloud of dust and she turns to look. A red barn and a silo stand far away.
